test_title: PYST 75: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The lions became violently / when the visitors / started throwing / stones at them.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the usage of the adverb "**violently**."
 
• The sentence should use the adjective "**violent**" to correctly describe the subject "lions."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**became violent**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The lions became violent when the visitors started throwing stones at them."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "stones at them."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "started throwing"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "when the visitors"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
